messages:
Marta Garcia: Scheduling onsite for candidate Alex M — Wed May 14 (PT). Full day 9:00am–3:00pm PT. Need panel availability, travel stipend confirmation, badge request, and any accessibility/dietary needs. Zoom fallback on event.

Leda (Recruiter): Alex prefers early flights, requires vegan lunch, wheelchair access, and needs a loaner Mac for the coding exercise. Asks about visa sponsorship timing (not currently US-authorized).

Kevin Wu: I can cover 9:30–11:00 onsite panel; happy to take infra slot. I don’t have a spare company Mac but can bring a personal one if ops loaner unavailable.

Marta Garcia: Ops will submit badge + accessibility. Can infra confirm loaner inventory (ref L-322)? @Kevin noted.

People Ops Bot: Badge request submitted — req#PR-7784. Visitor parking permit placed for 'Alex M.' ETA on badge: Thu 10:00am.

Leda (Recruiter): Travel stipend policy: domestic up to $500, expense code EXP-HIRE-2025. Candidate prefers ACH reimbursement; will provide bank details post-offer.

Marta Garcia: Instruct candidate to email receipts to hiring-expenses@redwood.com. I'll ping Payroll for ACH setup. For visa question, please loop Legal at legal@redwood.com for timeline guidance.

Kevin Wu: Panel confirmed: Kevin, Jana, Omar. Suggest 45m 'Infra deep-dive' at 10:15.

Marta Garcia: Calendar updated: 10:15–11:00 "Infra deep-dive" in Building A, 5th floor, Room 512. Zoom link on event. Note for candidate: bring gov ID to front desk; reception holds license for permit.

Leda (Recruiter): Candidate flight lands SFO 8:20am; taxi arranged. Will check in at front desk and present ID.

Marta Garcia: Ops loaner instructions if provided:
- Loaner tag: L-322
- Wipe & image: img-std-2025
- Install exam env: /opt/hiring/exam-setup.sh
- Loaner form: ops/loaner-form.pdf

Marta Garcia: Action items: (1) Ops confirm loaner availability (2) Payroll enable ACH (3) Legal respond on visa (4) Recruiter send final itinerary and receipts flow. React with :thumbsup: when done.

Kevin Wu: I can pick up loaner from Ops if available. :thumbsup:

Payroll Bot: Payroll notified for ACH enablement (ticket#PAY-4412).

People Ops Bot: Reminder created: loaner pickup Tue 4:00pm for L-322.

Leda (Recruiter): Thanks — will circulate final itinerary + onsite contact by EOD.
